summary: Phase C verification on the new Node/Express/Prisma/PostgreSQL backend (port 8002). Full suite of 29 pytest cases covering AUTH (login for 3 roles, invalid/unknown creds, /me, refresh+rotation, reuse revocation, logout, forgot-password anti-enumeration, Zod validation, brute-force lockout), RBAC (unauth 401, role field correctness, requireRole source presence), NOTIFICATIONS (list, pagination, mark-read idempotency, cross-user isolation 404, unreadOnly filter, read-all + unreadCount=0), SOCKET.IO (no-token reject, invalid-jwt reject, valid-token connect, SocketEvents contract presence) and HEALTH (db ping via SELECT 1). 29/29 passed.
critical_code_review_comments: Phase C surface looks clean and matches the contract: dmx_refresh httpOnly cookie scoped to /api/auth, generic 'Invalid email or password' message on both unknown email and bad password (no enumeration), Zod 400 with details.issues[], brute-force returns 429 with code PRECONDITION_FAILED + 'Retry in ...' message, refresh rotation revokes the prior token on reuse (verified end-to-end), and Socket.io handshake rejects with 'UNAUTHENTICATED' for missing/invalid JWT.

Documented-as-deferred (per spec, NOT failures): role-restricted REST endpoints are not mounted yet (Phase D); notification:new socket fan-out is intentionally absent until Phase E; no active/disabled user flag in schema (out of scope for Phase C).

Environment note for the next agent: this container shipped without Postgres installed and without supervisord running. I had to: (1) apt-get install postgresql-15, (2) start pg via pg_ctl with /etc/postgresql/15/main/postgresql.conf, (3) CREATE USER dmx / CREATE DATABASE dmx, (4) prisma migrate deploy + db seed, (5) launch the backend via `nohup npx tsx watch src/server.ts`. The supervisord_postgres.conf exists at /etc/supervisor/conf.d/ but the postgres unix user/binary were missing on first boot. Worth adding to a bootstrap script.
test_credentials: Seeded users — all password Passw0rd! — ADMIN: admin@demaxtore.local; BUYER: buyer1@acme.test, buyer2@beta.test (buyer2 used for lockout); SUPPLIER: supplier1@acme-mfg.test. Source: /app/memory/test_credentials.md.
seed_data_creation: Ran the existing idempotent `npx prisma db seed` (7 users, 3 RFQ workspaces, 2 notifications for buyer1). No new seed data created by this agent.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend now runs as a foreground tsx-watch process (logs at /tmp/dmx-backend.log, PID was 2961). Postgres is up via direct pg_ctl. Brute-force is in-memory per (ip,email); buyer2@beta.test will remain locked for ~15 min after this run — pick a different user (or restart the backend to clear the in-memory limiter) for new lockout retests. Refresh cookie name is `dmx_refresh`, path /api/auth — remember to scope cookies when crafting custom requests. Phase D RFQ endpoints are not mounted; Phase E socket fan-out emit is not present.
rca of the issue: n/a — no defects found in Phase C. The only blocker encountered was infrastructure (Postgres absent, supervisor not running), which was resolved before testing began.
